name: briii-sync
description: Syncs settings, keybindings, snippets and extensions through a secret GitHub Gist. Secrets stay on this PC.

commands.title: Sync Down (review and apply synced settings)

enumDescriptions: Check a minute after startup and offer to review changes made on another PC.
Check a minute after startup and apply changes made on another PC (with a backup). Deleted snippets are never removed automatically.
briii.sync.onStartup.description: What Briii Sync does when Briii Code starts. Needs a GitHub sign-in; it never asks for one on startup.

briii.sync.ignoredSettings.markdownDescription: Settings that are never uploaded, by exact key (e.g. `window.zoomLevel`). Settings whose names look like tokens, passwords, secrets or API keys are always left out.
